keranen2013_prague_1d.locator: GSA Data Repository 2013191, page 4, Figure DR1, dashed (best-fitting) Vp and Vs curves
keranen2013_prague_1d.reference: Keranen et al. (2013), Geology 41(6), 699-702; joint P/S velocity-hypocentre inversion of Prague aftershocks recorded on >15 stations
keranen2013_prague_1d.role: Local model used by Cochran et al. (2020) (the primary reference catalog); association and absolute location for the 2011 Prague case
keranen2013_prague_1d.derivation: scripts/models/digitize_keranen2013_dr1.py parses the PDF vector content stream (no raster digitising): dashed step polylines mapped with the figure's own axis frame; velocities to 1e-3 km/s, layer tops to 0.01 km. Check: the extracted Vp/Vs reproduces the separate Vp/Vs panel within 1.1 pt and places its 1.6/1.8 ticks under the printed labels.
keranen2013_prague_1d.vs_provenance: Inverted jointly with Vp in the source (not a fixed ratio); Vp/Vs 1.68-1.87.
keranen2013_prague_1d.depth_reference: Not stated in the source (depth below the surface assumed; local elevations ~0.3 km ASL).

layer_semantics.published_representation: Constant-velocity layers (step polylines); two sedimentary layers bounded by the top and bottom of the Arbuckle group, then basement with gradual variation.
layer_semantics.grid_use: Use velocity_layering: step (Maple Creek finding: linear ramps between tops bias origins).
